findings.what_happens: A screen reader cannot describe this image, so its information may be lost.
findings.who_is_affected: Blind and low-vision people using screen readers
findings.how_to_fix: Add concise alt text, or alt="" if purely decorative.

findings.what_happens: The purpose of this field is not announced, making it difficult to know what to enter.
findings.who_is_affected: People using screen readers or voice control
findings.how_to_fix: Associate a visible <label> with this field.

findings.what_happens: Assistive technology cannot tell the person what this button does.
findings.how_to_fix: Give the button visible text or an accessible name.

findings.what_happens: The link destination is not announced, so the person cannot decide whether to follow it.
findings.how_to_fix: Provide link text or meaningful alternative text for its image.

findings.what_happens: The embedded area has no announced name or purpose.
findings.how_to_fix: Add a concise title to the iframe.

findings.what_happens: The data has no identified column or row headings, so relationships are unclear.
findings.how_to_fix: Mark header cells with <th> and appropriate scope.

findings.what_happens: The page language is unknown, so spoken content may be pronounced incorrectly.
findings.how_to_fix: Set the correct lang attribute on the html element.

findings.what_happens: The section outline skips a level, making it harder to understand the page structure.
findings.how_to_fix: Use heading levels in a logical sequence.

findings.what_happens: This menu control may not be usable from the keyboard.
findings.how_to_fix: Use a native button and support keyboard activation.

findings.what_happens: This text is difficult to distinguish from its background.
findings.who_is_affected: People with low vision or reading in bright conditions
findings.how_to_fix: Increase text/background contrast to at least 4.5 to 1.
